# Patches

| Id | Reason | Files | Spec | Upstream |
|----|--------|-------|------|----------|
| OS-1 | Serverpod 4.1 compatibility: `OfflineSyncDatabase` implements `Database`, which gained `watch` and `unsafeWatch`. `watch` applies the same CRDT visibility/membership filter as `find` and re-runs when queried tables, `crdt_data_rows` or memberships change. | `lib/src/database/database.dart` | suite 12 §4 | to be upstreamed |
| OS-2 | Web deadlock: `_spaceIdsForQueries` runs membership lookups in the caller's transaction (web SQLite has one connection behind one lock). | `lib/src/database/database.dart` | suite 12 §4 | to be upstreamed |
| OS-3 | Infra: `resolution: workspace` and version `0.0.9` (was `0.0.9+wonky.1`) so the copy is a workspace member instead of a root path override. Serverpod Cloud only uploads workspace packages the server depends on; a path override to a folder outside them breaks the cloud `pub get`. The hosted `serverpod_offline_sync_client`/`_server` pin `0.0.9` exactly. | `pubspec.yaml` | suite 01 §2.3 | not upstreamable |
| OS-4 | Concurrent inserts of the same row id (Sheets' deterministic cell ids: one device types a value, another formats the same cell offline) merged as whole rows: the insert with the newer HLC overwrote every column, so the other device's value was lost. Now an insert of an existing row merges per column: a column the insert leaves null is not authored by it (never overwrites), and a null domain value without field metadata counts as never authored (any non-null value wins it); an older insert is no longer dropped up front. Converges because every replica applies the same per-column rule. | `lib/src/database/merge.dart` (`_applyMergeInsert`, `_applyMergeInsertForExistingRow`, `_shouldMergeFieldMetadataIfNewer`) | Sheets 10 §10 #3, suite 12 §2.1 | to be upstreamed |
| OS-5 | A space whose rows the app purged after eviction (upstream U2 workaround, Sheets weekly purge) came back without the rows this device had authored: the space handshake always sends `Hlc.now(localNode)` so the peer never returns the local node's own changes. Now a space without any local `crdt_data_rows` sends `Hlc.zero(localNode)` and receives everything. A space with rows behaves as before. | `lib/src/sync/engine.dart` (`createSyncSinceHlc`) | suite 12 §2.3 | to be upstreamed (with U2) |
| OS-6 | Deleting rows ran the full foreign-key projection of the table's FK component after every delete statement (~1 ms per row: a 5,000-cell revert took 12 s on the server). Deleting rows of a table nothing references and without unique indexes (Sheets `cell`) cannot change any other row's projection; the tombstones already hide the deleted rows, so the projection is skipped for such tables. Deletes of referenced tables (rows, columns, sheets) still project. | `lib/src/database/recorder.dart` (`insteadOfDelete`), `lib/src/database/merge_utils/foreign_key_projector.dart` (`deleteNeedsProjection`) | Sheets 10 §6 (restores), 12 §2.4 | to be upstreamed |
